correctness.rationale: Independent reconstruction of the exact fourth-moment formula q^(-5) sum_(c,t) |sum_(Q(h)=t)f(c+h)f(c-h)|^2 from orthogonality and the bijective center/half-difference coordinates. The norm-map gives L_0=1 and L_t=q+1 for t!=0 for every q=3 (mod4) prime power; affine line collisions yield q(q-1)H for zero-mean h, and the weighted antipodal sum equals -qH. Expanding f=1+eps(r+is) and the squared normalized l2 norm yields quadratic coefficients 2-2/q+4/q² (real) and 2-2/q (imaginary), with the two scalar complex directions the only kernel. Independently checked the exact algebra and sample q=3,7,11, including normalization; finite checks merely corroborate the all-field argument. No claim of global uniform stability or uniform nonlinear remainder.
